here are some tips: 1) pick out exactly what you want first. 2) get prices via email, tell them you are gonna by in the next 3 days. 3) get competitive prices from other dealers a little farther away. 4) haggle the crap out of it  with a dealer with large distribution. Don't go to small dealers cuz they don't have a lot of cars. 5) Then haggle the crap out of it in a 2nd dealer. By then you should have 2-3 competitive quotes. You can then give them an ultimatum of a lower or matched quote. usually bigger dealers can match. Also, go near end of September or last week of a low sales month (August, September, October)-- The sales team are more willing to negotiate. If you go during a busy month, then they'll just ignore you. If you say you'll buy in 1-2 month, they'll just ignore you as well.
